challenge.better_approach: Make reseal and clearance read the proof from somewhere already declared (bounds.in, or the falsifier): bounds.in holds every written file, not the red ones, so it cannot say which proof is the red the fix answers, and outline 17.11.7.2 asks that the ticket NAME the red. Declaring the one field both readers already use is the smallest change.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That fixes is plan, not state: it names what the build answers, set at cast and not moved by crossings, so it belongs with bounds and falsifier. Paths resolve against the cairn root as clearance.py:_abs and reseal.py both do.
challenge.prior_art: e8be83a46ea9 built reseal's y path (2026-11-01) reading fixes; 284798998ab0 (2026-10-29) partitioned the fields into plan/state/log before fixes existed, and nobody added it after. cd8a1de6139c and e4f02a1ceef5 are the precedent for adding a shaped plan field (chart, measured), which test_the_ticket_is_three_files admits only when shaped.
challenge.real_collision: None: outline 17.11.7.2 asks for exactly this field; the charter's omission contradicts it. Distinction recorded: requiring fixes on every bug at cast is NOT added (clearance's BUILDME rule already demands it at the crossing).

answers.falsifier: RED if a bug doc carrying a well-shaped fixes is refused at cast, or if a malformed fixes (not a list, empty, blank, or a path that resolves to nothing) is admitted.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator relayed cc_0's finding, re-measured here: cast_ticket over a scratch store refused a bug doc with 'fixes is not a plan, state or log field' (script /tmp/claude-1000/-home-akien-cairn/8914d998-8455-4806-a582-fc644dec7250/scratchpad/measure_fixes.py), while cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py:430 reads ticket.get('fixes')
answers.how: The store charter (CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json) declares fixes in plan_fields and shapes it in plan_shapes (a non-empty list of non-blank repo-relative paths, each resolving to a file); transitions._shape_lacks enforces that shape at cast. Red-first proof casts into a scratch commons.
answers.traces_to: Law 4 (the fixit rule is physics in reseal.py and clearance.py, but the door in front of it refuses the field it reads, so the rule only ever ran on fixtures) and Law 8 (a fixit's proof of entry is the red it names; it has to be nameable).
answers.what: A bug ticket can be cast carrying fixes, the list of proofs whose red it fixes, so the fixit rule (outline 17.11.7.2) is reachable by a real ticket and not only by a fixture written straight to disk.

bullets.text: No ticket in the store has ever carried fixes: the fixit rule in reseal.py and clearance.py has run only over fixtures written to disk, which bypass the cast door. cc_0 had to recast 24f60e45304c as a code-seam to get through.
